candidates.title: The Sun

tarot.title: Marseille structure · reflective edition 1
tarot.description: Complete 78-card text deck. Original Cleromancy reflective prompts, not historical translations or reproduced artwork. Correspondence traditions are independent overlays, not claims about the deck maker. Minor-card prompts are fixed GPT-6/Codex-assisted editorial templates; major prompts preserve the earlier authored text. No per-reading prose generation.

sources.title: The Pictorial Key to the Tarot
sources.author: A. E. Waite; illustrations by Pamela Colman Smith
sources.locator: Part II, VIII Strength and XI Justice; Part III, four suits and ranks. Text-only edition, no reproduced illustrations.

sources.title: Tarot de Jean Noblet; conventional ordering described by Waite
sources.author: Bibliothèque nationale de France; A. E. Waite
sources.locator: Historical structural reference, not a facsimile: 73 of 78 Noblet cards survive. This complete text deck uses conventional VIII Justice / XI Strength and an unnumbered Fool, as contrasted in Waite II.VIII.

sources.title: Book T: The Tarot (Mathers/Felkin transcription)
sources.author: S. L. MacGregor Mathers and Harriet Felkin
sources.locator: Tables pp. 3–7; Aces pp. 9–11. No publication year asserted for this transcription.

sources.title: The General Book of the Tarot
sources.author: A. E. Thierens
sources.locator: Part I: Lesser Arcana (suit elements); Part II: named Greater Arcana entries.
